programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: In Ethiopia, one and a half million people are blind.Martyna had the opportunity to meet representatives of the charity organization "Himalayan Cataract Project", which deals with free sight restoration for people from the poorest regions of the world.She accompanied several women in their everyday lives.The blind Muria, a nurse named Abeba, and the talented doctor Somega.The traveler had the opportunity to observe the course of eye surgery at the Ouiha hospital.She also attended a school for blind children in Mekele who learn Braille.They dream of being journalists and telling people about their life in Ethiopia.These dreams can come true thanks to the Himalayan Cataract Project foundation.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska and her team visit the Nyaru Menteng center, where orphaned orangutans find shelter.About sixty thousand representatives of this species live in Borneo.Their population is decreasing at an alarming rate, which is related to the devastation of the environment.At the Indonesian rehabilitation center, Martyna meets several exceptional women: the director of the center, Michelle, and the orangutan caregivers who take care of the little ones 24 hours a day and teach them the art of surviving in the wild.
